title: Mukhyamantri Amrutam (MA) Yojana – Gujarat Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Government health assurance programme for eligible economically vulnerable families, providing cashless treatment for specified procedures.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility is based on current Gujarat government beneficiary categories and household/economic criteria; verify with the state beneficiary system.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Mukhyamantri Amrutam (MA) Yojana – Gujarat.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
